title: This AI Dashboard Looks Right… But the Math Is WRONG! #shorts
description:
One tiny refund can make an AI-generated sales dashboard misleading. Our fictional example has sales of ₹120, ₹95 and ₹110 plus a ₹25 refund. Gross sales are ₹325 and correct net sales are ₹300; adding the refund as positive shows the wrong ₹350. We calculate this ourselves — it is NOT footage of a real Gemini 4 Argon run. Google's new Gemini 4 Argon is designed for complex reasoning and coding, but it can still be important to verify the output.

Would you BUILD a dashboard with AI or CHECK every number? Tell us why. Watch the long explanation on FlowMinute Lab.

Official Google announcement: https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/introducing-gemini-4-argon/
Developer capability guide: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model
Original illustrative animations. Background images derived from licensed Pexels footage previously used in FlowMinute Lab production; not Google demo footage.
